comments.body: Every attempt gets the full configured timeout (5 s), however little time the caller has left. wallet::send_payment wraps send in a 10 s deadline (src/wallet/pay.rs:57): attempt 2 starts after just over 5 s, the deadline cancels it before its own timeout, the third attempt never runs, and the wallet reports Offline although attempt 1 or 2 may have reached the node.
